## Changes / 改动

Describe what changed and why. 说明改了什么，以及为什么需要改。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `docker compose config --quiet`
- [ ] Tested the connection flow in two browsers, if relevant / 两个浏览器的连接流程已验证，若相关
- [ ] Tested mobile file transfer, if relevant / 手机端文件流程已验证，若相关

## Boundaries / 边界

- [ ] No keys, private TURN endpoints, credentials, or packet captures are included / 没有提交密钥、真实 TURN 地址、凭据或抓包信息
- [ ] English and Chinese copy is in sync / 英文与中文文案已同步
- [ ] Local storage, protocol, privacy, and deployment changes are documented / 已说明本地存储、协议、隐私或部署配置的变化
